title: Intersections of Cantor sets with hyperbolas and continuous images
summary: Given $λ\in (0,1/2)$, let \begin{equation*} C_λ=\set{(1-λ)\sum_{i=1}^\infty d_iλ^{i-1}:d_i\in\set{0,1}} \end{equation*} be the middle Cantor sets with convex hull $[0, 1]$. We are interested in the set $S_t=\set{(x,y)\in C_λ\times C_λ: xy=t}$, where $t\in[0,1]$. Since the cases where $t=0$ or $t=1$ are trivial, we assume that $t\in(0,1)$ in what follows. We show that there exists a $λ_0=0.4302$ such that for all $λ$ satisfying $λ_0 \le λ< 1/2$, the set $S_t$ has the cardinality of the continuum for every $t \in (0,1)$.
